d:
Kendriy mantri chirag pasvan ne desh men startaap aur udyamita ko barhava dene ko lekar yuvaon se khas apil ki hai. unhonne yuvaon ko nae aaidiya ke sath aage aane aur apna karobar shuru karne ke lie prerit kiya. aakhir chirag pasvan ne startaap ko lekar yuvaon se kya kaha? sunie unka pura sandesh..
'bihar tak' (Bihar Tak) ek aisa manch hai jahan khabron se lekar itihas tak sabkuchh hai. to garv se kaho, ham bihari hain.
